content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Leavenworth

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific thresholds for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project experience, or equivalent alternative pathways. Verify your qualifications before enrollment to ensure you'll meet application requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend sessions from your Leavenworth location on your schedule; our synchronous online format keeps you connected to active certified practitioners and peers. You'll cover all five process groups and ten knowledge areas required for exam readiness.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the 35-hour course, register with PMI and submit your formal certification application, including your work history and training documentation. Pay the required exam fee directly to PMI. Plan ahead; processing typically takes several weeks, so apply promptly after your coursework ends.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor feedback—to build confidence. Schedule your PMP exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. On exam day, you'll answer 180 questions across three hours, demonstrating mastery of project-management frameworks and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle by earning professional development units (PDUs). Pursue continuing education, volunteer leadership, or published work in project management to stay current. Renew your credential before expiration to keep your competitive edge in Leavenworth's job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.
